sprint: BACKLOG.md -- Doodle/Shape Fidelity: Real-Render Leakage Clip + Pad Aspect-Ratio Correction (root Studio only)
task: Closes BACKLOG.md's bug line, verbatim: 'Doodle drawn vs doodle shown has differences in line stroke thickness and space covered. also there is leakage from doodle sketch area to outside area. the same is with shape when painted.' Two independent, root-caused defects, both fixed. Fix 1 (leakage): renderer/slideRenderer.js's _drawSceneDoodle(st) only ever wrapped its drawing in save/restore conditionally on rotation and never clipped to its own bounding rect -- a wide/round-capped stroke near the object's own edge could paint outside its declared box once on the real page canvas, unlike the small pad element which can never leak past its own physical boundary. Fixed by always building a Path2D rect matching the object's bounding rect and clipping inside the same rotation transform, mirroring the save()/clip(path)/restore() idiom already proven for Shape's own Paint Inside fill. Fix 2 (stroke thickness/coverage mismatch): js/cardDesigner.js's live-editing pad normalized every stroke/silhouette point as a flat fraction of the pad's own bare square, with zero awareness of the real object's own w:h aspect ratio -- a non-square Doodle/Shape drew against the wrong proportions on the pad versus what the real renderer (which correctly uses the object's true w/h box) actually painted. Fixed with a new _padActiveRect(padSize,objectW,objectH) helper computing a letterboxed active rectangle matching the object's real aspect ratio, with every stroke/silhouette point now mapped against it via new _shapePaintNormalizePoints/_doodleNormalizePoints helpers; _padStrokeWidth simplified to take the precomputed scale directly; a new _padLetterFont mirrors the real renderer's letter/number auto-fit sizing. Verified via the full remaining regression matrix: manageframes_inline_rotation_verify.js's failure confirmed via a decisive git-stash A/B to be a pre-existing, unrelated test-script bug (a missing second argument to ProjectStore.create), reproducing identically on the unmodified baseline; coloring_kit_verify.js and place_resize_shape_verify.js similarly reconfirmed as pre-existing/unrelated staleness. Two real test-script bugs (a missing playwright require fallback, a stale assumption that Add Something always starts closed) were found and fixed in shapes_paint_inside_verify.js itself, re-run clean at 30/30. Full regression: both goldenBuild.js suites (World Builder v1 and v2) PASS unchanged; verify_image_rotation.js (19/0), verify_rotation_publish_honored.js (10/0), verify_text_rotation.js (22/0), verify_text_rotation_pivot.js (5/0), and manageframes_inline_rotation_verify2.js (16/0) all pass unchanged, confirming the rotation-under-clip transform interplay composes correctly everywhere else it's already used. No Theme Contract/Engine V2 Scene Model/Builder architecture change; confined to renderer/slideRenderer.js and js/cardDesigner.js.
